live_passes: Exact UTC stamp, owner, timeout, reason, and probe fields for sign-in and screen holds
Dale-step --until refused before task creation; ordinary deferrals preserved
Failed, unknown, and timed-out probes retain their holds without queue or parent-channel wakes; timed-out process subtree removed
Local disposable service sign-in releases an actual hold automatically and emits exactly one durable watcher wake
Changing either stamp or probe during a passing probe retains the changed hold
Ordinary re-holds clear historical probes for both active and released sign-in/screen holds
Partial release with a broken parent binding reports failure; retries finalize once without rerunning the probe
